lines: ## DYN-13 controlled failure
### First attempt — Blocked before request
A second `next dev` process was started with an intentionally invalid provider
key. Next.js rejected it because the project development lock was held by the
main server. The later `curl` therefore could not connect to port 3101. No
application request occurred and owner B retained zero profiles and sessions.
### Retry — Executed
After stopping the main server, the fault-injection server started on port
3101. Owner B had zero profiles and sessions before the request. The artificial
question `What is photosynthesis?` produced:
```text
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
DYN13_RETRY_ELAPSED=1.255217
```json
"error": {
"code": "SESSION_GENERATION_FAILED",
"message": "Unable to prepare the explanation right now"
After the request, owner B had one default profile and zero sessions. The
server logged only the domain-level message `Unable to generate the learning
session`; no provider response detail or credential appeared in the client
response. This verifies controlled failure and absence of partial session
persistence. The UI recovery presentation was not observed.

record.Expected visible result: Safe error appears with HTTP 502 and retained question
record.Actual result: With the controlled invalid provider key, the Home page retained “What is photosynthesis?” and displayed “Unable to prepare the explanation right now”. The corresponding HAR entry returned HTTP 502 with code `SESSION_GENERATION_FAILED` and no raw provider detail.

record.Expected visible result: Unchanged question succeeds after normal provider restart
record.Actual result: After restoring the normal provider configuration, the same question created and rendered a Photosynthesis learning session successfully. The corresponding HAR entry returned HTTP 201.

simple.en: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to make their own food using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide. It turns light energy into chemical energy stored in sugar.
simple.my: Photosynthesis ဆိုတာ အပင်တွေက နေရောင်ခြည်၊ ရေနဲ့ carbon dioxide ကို အသုံးပြုပြီး ကိုယ်တိုင် အစာတည်ဆောက်တဲ့ လုပ်ငန်းစဉ်ပါ။ အလင်းစွမ်းအင်ကို sugar ထဲမှာ သိမ်းထားတဲ့ chemical energy အဖြစ် ပြောင်းပေးတယ်။

realWorldExample.en: A green leaf in sunlight takes in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the roots, then makes glucose. That glucose helps the plant grow and gives it energy.
realWorldExample.my: နေရောင်ထဲက အရွက်စိမ်းတစ်ရွက်က လေထဲက carbon dioxide ကိုယူပြီး အမြစ်ကနေ ရေကိုရယူတယ်။ ပြီးတော့ glucose ကိုတည်ဆောက်တယ်။ အဲဒီ glucose က အပင်ကြီးထွားဖို့နဲ့ စွမ်းအင်ရဖို့ သုံးတယ်။

technical.en: Photosynthesis is a biochemical process in chloroplasts where chlorophyll captures light energy and uses it to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. It is the main way autotrophs produce organic matter.
technical.my: Photosynthesis ဆိုတာ chloroplast ထဲမှာဖြစ်တဲ့ biochemical process ပါ။ chlorophyll က အလင်းစွမ်းအင်ကို ဖမ်းယူပြီး carbon dioxide နဲ့ ရေကို glucose နဲ့ oxygen အဖြစ် ပြောင်းပေးတယ်။ Autotrophs တွေ organic matter ထုတ်လုပ်တဲ့ အဓိကနည်းလမ်းလည်း ဖြစ်တယ်။

reflectivePrompt.en: Why do you think plants need sunlight to make food instead of getting food the way animals do?
reflectivePrompt.my: အပင်တွေက နေရောင်ခြည်ကို ဘာကြောင့်လိုအပ်လဲ။ တိရစ္ဆာန်တွေလို အစာကို အဆင်သင့်ယူမရတာနဲ့ ဘာဆိုင်လဲ။

hint.en: Think about how light energy can be stored in sugar.
hint.my: အလင်းစွမ်းအင်ကို sugar ထဲမှာ ဘယ်လိုသိမ်းနိုင်မလဲဆိုတာ စဉ်းစားကြည့်ပါ။
